Definition: ; also (compare) κατωτέρω (compare G2737); adverb from G2596; downwards:--beneath, bottom, down, under.
BiblicalUsage: Kato means down, beneath, to the bottom. Matthew 27:51 says the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom, and Acts 2:19 promises signs in the earth beneath.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe down is where God meets us: the veil tore from top to bottom so the way in was open.
